items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: That's the first time I met King and Barney.

ctx.x: Oh, that's what I wanted to ask you. When you all were in Washington, did King Oliver's band ever come through there.

Not when I was there, no. They came to New York. They came to the Savoy. We were in New York then. We were at the Cotton Club then. That's the first time. That's the first time I met King and Barney. Barney was with them, lot of guys. That's the first time we met Barney.
What kind of guys -- how did his band sound.
